descriptionByLocale.it:
Come analista di Insights nel dipartimento di strategia del prodotto, avrete una grande opportunità di fornire l'autorità di analisi ai diversi stakeholder interni e team di gestione. Porterai le relative analisi, raccomandazioni e intuizioni attuabili per modellare il processo decisionale, sostenere progetti e obiettivi, iniziative strategiche e decision-making.
La vostra missione:

• Raccogliere, interpretare e presentare i dati per informare meglio le decisioni aziendali.

• Partecipa al successo e alla visione del prodotto aiutando con la ricerca, i dati, i report e le informazioni necessarie.

• Sostegno con approfondimenti la pianificazione strategica e l'ideazione, così come i progetti chiave della roadmap e le principali iniziative di progetto.

• Proprietà Dashboard: sviluppare dashboard di prodotto, mantenerli, e eseguire miglioramenti e modifiche necessarie.

• Preparare la ricerca e i report per la gestione del prodotto e i team che comunicano efficacemente conclusioni e modelli utilizzando i dati pertinenti.

• Comunicare rapporti e risultati dell'analisi dei dati al dipartimento, nonché i principali stakeholder di diversi dipartimenti della Banca.

• I risultati attuali e le raccomandazioni strategiche per la leadership esecutivo, fornendo chiare narrazioni supportate da dati forti.

• Assicurare qualità, convalida e documentazione di report.

• Contribuisci alla continua evoluzione delle migliori pratiche e strumenti analitici all'interno del team.

• Assistere la gestione del prodotto come necessario in qualsiasi fase di Insights attività di dati e di ricerca o esigenze.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali per sostenere iniziative che richiedono competenze analitiche profonde.

• Corso di laurea (analisi dati, business, economia).

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante in Business Analytics e/o Reporting, preferibilmente nei servizi finanziari o negli ambienti tecnologici.

• Competenze ed esperienza nella creazione di dashboard con software Tableau e competenze SQL. Python è un vantaggio.

• Competenze eccellenti nei fogli di calcolo di Excel e la creazione di presentazioni in PowerPoint.

• Forte alfabetizzazione dei dati: capacità di manipolare, interpretare e sintetizzare set di dati complessi con alta precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Mindset analitico, abilità numeriche e pensiero critico eccellente.

• Forte acume aziendale e pensiero strategico; capace di collegare intuizioni di dati ai risultati aziendali.

• Esperienza comprovata che influenza gli stakeholder e lavora con leadership senior per guidare decisioni strategiche.

• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali.

• Capacità di gestire più priorità, operare autonomamente, e soddisfare scadenze strette in un ambiente frenetico.

• Mindset collaborativo, orientamento del cliente e dedizione al miglioramento continuo e all'apprendimento.

• Fluente in inglese e francese, il tedesco è un plus.

SQ3
descriptionByLocale.en:
As an Insights analyst in the Product Strategy department, you will have a great opportunity to provide empowering analytics to the different internal stakeholders and Management team. You will bring the relevant analysis, recommendations, and actionable insights to shape data-driven decision making, support projects and goals, strategic initiatives, and decision-making.
Your mission:

• Collect, interpret, and present the data to inform better business decisions.

• Participate in product success and vision by assisting with necessary research, data, reports, and insights.

• Support with insights the strategic planning and ideation, as well as key projects of the roadmap and the main project initiatives.

• Dashboard ownership: develop product dashboards, maintain them, and perform necessary improvements and modifications.

• Prepare research and reports for the Product management and teams that effectively communicate conclusions and patterns using relevant data.

• Communicate reports and results of data analysis to the department, as well as the main stakeholders from different departments of the Bank.

• Present findings and strategic recommendations to Executive leadership, delivering clear narratives supported by strong data.

• Ensure quality, validation, and documentation of reporting.

• Contribute to the continuous evolution of analytical best practices and tools within the team.

• Assist Product management as necessary at any phase of Insights data and research activities or needs.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support initiatives requiring deep analytical expertise.

• Bachelor’s degree (Data analytics, Business, Economics).

• At least 3 years of relevant work experience in Business Analytics and/or Reporting, preferably in financial services or technology environments.

• Skills and experience in creating dashboards with Tableau software and SQL skills. Python is a plus.

• Excellent skills in Excel spreadsheets and creating presentations in PowerPoint.

• Strong data literacy: ability to manipulate, interpret, and synthesize complex datasets with high accuracy and attention to detail.

• Analytical mindset, numerical skills, and excellent critical thinking.

• Strong business acumen and strategic thinking; capable of connecting data insights to business outcomes.

• Proven experience influencing stakeholders and working with senior leadership to drive strategic decisions.

• Very good written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate autonomously, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative mindset, customer-first orientation, and dedication to continuous improvement and learning.

• Fluent in English and French, German is a plus.

SQ3
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Insights-Analyst in der Produktstrategie-Abteilung haben Sie eine großartige Gelegenheit, den verschiedenen internen Stakeholdern und dem Management-Team befähigende Analysen zur Verfügung zu stellen. Sie bringen die relevanten Analysen, Empfehlungen und umsetzbaren Erkenntnisse mit, um datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung zu gestalten, Projekte und Ziele, strategische Initiativen und Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.
Ihre Mission:

• Sammeln, interpretieren und präsentieren Sie die Daten, um bessere Geschäftsentscheidungen zu treffen.

• Beteiligen Sie sich am Erfolg und der Vision von Produkten, indem Sie bei notwendigen Recherchen, Daten, Berichten und Erkenntnissen helfen.

• Unterstützung mit Insights bei der strategischen Planung und Ideenfindung sowie bei Schlüsselprojekten der Roadmap und den Hauptprojektinitiativen.

• Dashboard-Besitz: Produkt-Dashboards entwickeln, pflegen und notwendige Verbesserungen und Modifikationen durchführen.

• Bereiten Sie Recherchen und Berichte für das Produktmanagement und Teams vor, die Schlussfolgerungen und Muster unter Verwendung relevanter Daten effektiv kommunizieren.

• Kommunizieren Sie Berichte und Ergebnisse der Datenanalyse an die Abteilung sowie die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus verschiedenen Abteilungen der Bank.

• Präsentieren Sie Ergebnisse und strategische Empfehlungen an die Führungskräfte und liefern Sie klare Narrative, die durch solide Daten unterstützt werden.

• Gewährleistung der Qualität, Validierung und Dokumentation der Berichterstattung.

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der analytischen Best Practices und Tools innerhalb des Teams.

• Unterstützung des Produktmanagements bei Bedarf in jeder Phase von Insights-Daten und Forschungsaktivitäten oder -bedürfnissen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Initiativen zu unterstützen, die fundiertes analytisches Fachwissen erfordern.

• Bachelor-Abschluss (Data Analytics, Business, Economics).

• Mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in Business Analytics und / oder Reporting, vorzugsweise in Finanzdienstleistungen oder Technologieumgebungen.

• Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Dashboards mit Tableau-Software und SQL-Fähigkeiten. Python ist ein Plus.

• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten in Excel-Tabellen und Erstellen von Präsentationen in PowerPoint.

• Starke Datenkompetenz: Fähigkeit, komplexe Datensätze mit hoher Genauigkeit und Detailgenauigkeit zu manipulieren, zu interpretieren und zu synthetisieren.

• Analytische Denkweise, numerische Fähigkeiten und exzellentes kritisches Denken.

• Starker Geschäftssinn und strategisches Denken; in der Lage, Datenerkenntnisse mit Geschäftsergebnissen zu verbinden.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Beeinflussung von Stakeholdern und der Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, um strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

• Sehr gute schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten, autonom zu arbeiten und enge Fristen in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung einzuhalten.

• Kollaborative Denkweise, Kundenorientierung und Engagement für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Lernen.

• Fließend in Englisch und Französisch, Deutsch ist ein Plus.

SQ3

• Un état d'esprit analytique, des compétences numériques et une excellente pensée critique.

• Un bon sens des affaires et une réflexion stratégique solide; capable de relier les données recueillies aux résultats opérationnels.

• Expérience éprouvée qui a influencé les intervenants et travaillé avec les cadres supérieurs pour diriger les décisions stratégiques.

• Très bonnes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

• Capacité de gérer de multiples priorités, d'opérer de façon autonome et de respecter des délais serrés dans un environnement rapide.

• L'esprit de collaboration, l'orientation client-premier, et le dévouement à l'amélioration et à l'apprentissage continus.

• Fluent en anglais et en français, l'allemand est un plus.

In qualità di agente di gestione delle registrazioni all'interno del nostro dipartimento di Servizi Campus, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione digitale dei nostri processi interni. Sarete responsabili della digitalizzazione, dell'indicizzazione e della classificazione dei documenti fisici ed elettronici per garantire la loro accessibilità, conformità e conservazione a lungo termine. Questa posizione è ideale per qualcuno orientato al dettaglio, organizzato e motivato da un continuo miglioramento dei flussi di lavoro dei documenti. Le tue responsabilità:
• digitalizzazione dei documenti — Preparare, scansionare e eseguire controlli di qualità sui documenti in arrivo.
• Indicizzazione strutturata — Assegna metadati accurati per garantire il recupero rapido e affidabile.
• Classificazione dei documenti — Organizzare i record digitali e fisici secondo gli standard interni.
• Controllo della qualità — Verificare accuratezza, leggibilità e coerenza dei file digitalizzati.
• Gestione del flusso di lavoro dei documenti — Contribuire a ottimizzare i processi di archiviazione e flusso di informazioni.
• Supporto interno — Squadre di assistenza con ricerche documentali, recupero e consultazione.

• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in questa funzione o simile
• Confortevole con strumenti di scansione, sistemi di gestione dei documenti e ambienti digitali.
• Forte capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli, e stretta adesione alle procedure.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre collabora con più dipartimenti.
• Competenza in francese e inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Records Management Agent within our Campus Services department, you will play a key role in the digital transformation of our internal processes. You will be responsible for the digitization, indexing, and classification of physical and electronic documents to ensure their accessibility, compliance, and long-term preservation.
This position is ideal for someone detail oriented, organized, and motivated by continuous improvement in document workflows.
Your responsibilities:

• Document digitization — Prepare, scan, and perform quality checks on incoming documents.

• Structured indexing — Assign accurate metadata to ensure fast and reliable retrieval.

• Document classification — Organize digital and physical records according to internal standards.

• Quality control — Verify accuracy, readability, and consistency of digitized files.

• Document workflow management — Contribute to optimizing archiving and information flow processes.

• Internal support — Assist teams with document searches, retrieval, and consultation.

• “Agente en information documentaire CFC / Agent en information documentaire CFC” or equivalent

• At least 2 years of experience in this function or similar

• Comfortable with scanning tools, document management systems and digital environments.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and strict adherence to procedures.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple departments.

• Proficiency in French and English

responsabilità

descriptionByLocale.en:
After an initial training period covering our banking and trading platforms, Oracle databases, internal Python-based tools, and financial products, you will join our Application & Business Support team and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of Swissquote's production systems.
Your mission will be to investigate complex business and technical issues, support critical banking and trading operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our internal processes and tools.
Responsibilities

• Investigate and resolve complex incidents impacting our banking, trading and forex platforms.

• Act as a primary point of contact for internal departments requiring technical and business support.

• Perform root cause analysis on production issues and coordinate with development teams when escalations are required.

• Analyze large datasets and conduct investigations using SQL (Oracle, Postgres).

• Maintain and improve monitoring processes to ensure the reliability of our systems and services.

descriptionByLocale.en:
You will join the IT Department’s IT Platform Operations team, whose role is to operate the layer between raw infrastructure and the bank’s corporate-facing services: the application-tier middleware fabric, the Kubernetes control plane, and the user-facing surface of the bank’s Sovereign AI Platform.
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in operating Kubernetes-native platform engineering systems at scale, and will lead the integration of open-source AI tooling within a regulated corporate environment while ensuring large language model (LLM) inference scales. Your expertise will help your team deliver the platform on which the bank provides governed access to internal and external AI capabilities — distributed inference, agentic workflows, notebooks, and chatbots — built on top of the GPU and serving substrate provided by the Systems & Storage teams.
With your team, you will work closely with IT Architects, Observability & Performance Analysts, the Cybersecurity function and the Systems teams to plan and execute the department’s long-term objective of a sovereign AI capability that runs under the bank’s own governance — data sovereignty, content safety, prompt-injection defenses, agentic-workflow audit, and cost control on external API spend — and that is AI Act- and DORA-ready by design.

• Design, deploy and operate distributed LLM inference (LLM-d) on Kubernetes — sizing for throughput, tail latency and GPU utilisation against the serving substrate provided by IT Systems Services (ITSS).

• Operate and harden the user-facing AI surface: the Open WebUI cross-department chatbot, JupyterHub notebooks for data scientists, and the agent catalog (agentregistry).

• Build and operate Agentgateway as the governed routing layer to external providers (Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI GPT API), enforcing traffic policy, rate limiting, cost controls and audit logging.

• Implement content-safety, prompt-injection defense and agentic-workflow audit controls, plus the agent-identity model required for EU AI Act and DORA compliance.

• Operate the Kubernetes control plane — etcd, API server, scheduler and controller-manager — with HA sizing and surge-upgrade discipline; contribute to multi-cluster management for the meshed cross-cluster pattern.

• Define SLOs and instrument the platform for performance and availability; lead incident response across the AI platform and control-plane critical path.

• Automate platform provisioning and configuration through Infrastructure as Code and governed automation (AAP), keeping every deployment repeatable, reviewable and auditable.

• Develop and maintain architecture documentation and operational runbooks, and participate in the 24×7 on-call rotation.

Minimum Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering, with at least 3 years operating production Kubernetes and/or machine-learning serving workloads at scale.

• Proven experience managing complex, mission-critical IT environments and contributing to large-scale platform projects.

• Experience in regulated or high-assurance industries such as banking, telco, aviation, pharmaceutics or government.

• Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals, container runtimes, distributed systems, networking and cloud-native security.

• Excellent interpersonal skills, capable of working with multi-functional technical and business teams, along with different levels of management to influence decision making.
Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with LLM-d or comparable distributed inference / model-serving frameworks (e.g. vLLM, TGI, NVIDIA Triton, Ray Serve, KServe).

• Experience operating JupyterHub, Open WebUI, or similar multi-tenant notebook and chatbot platforms.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes-native agentic frameworks (e.g. kagent), AI traffic-routing / gateway layers (e.g. Agentgateway), and agent-registry / catalog patterns.

• Experience integrating and governing external LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT) — routing, rate limiting, cost control and audit.

• Proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, Go, Rust, Java, C++.

• Comfortable with Infrastructure as Code and governed automation tooling (Ansible / AAP, Terraform, etc.); familiarity with event streaming (Apache Kafka) and observability stacks.
